Question: Salaam... My problem is my child don't come near me he always attached to my mother-in-law...My son call my mother-in-law mummy and father-in-law papa...For me he call assiya mummy and for his father he called assad papa....At time of his birth i went into depression so my mother-in-law use to look after him....But now each every work of him i do but still he want to be near my mother-in-law...He even sleep with my mother-in-law...I want my son back..he is seven year old.I want he should be near me and love me...I don't want to sepearte him from my mother-in-law but he should understand difference between us.He should give pirority as his mother...Please give me any dua or wazifa as soon as possible....Thanks Allahafiz.... Answer ID: 22402 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1006/816/B=1431) If the child has reached up to seven of his age, then you can take your child and keep him in your care. Try to make him friendly, in-sha-Allah in future you will get success. Recite the following surah extensively: حسبنا الله و نعم الوكيل Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
